title: Nvidia joins Firmus's $505M round at $5.5B valuation

sources.quote: The raise, announced on 6 April 2026 and led by Coatue Management with continued participation from Nvidia, is the third equity round Firmus has completed in six months, bringing total equity raised in that period to approximately $1.35bn.

explain: Nvidia invested again in Firmus's $505 million round at a $5.5 billion valuation. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.
